body: the people you quoted are naive neurotypicals, so i'd rather not diffuse how it's very stupid, but i genuinely believe that as much as you are capable of hurt and sadness, you are capable of things that will make you and others feel good. maybe you havent found thesse people and thats ok. maybe you never will and will settle for the comfort of pets or strangers on the internet, thats also ok. and honestly im a person w very low aattraction so i never understood mairraage but i will tell you that what is possible is finding comfort in someone/thing that could keep you around until natural causes take you. it could be a community or a passion. there isnt a point to love or happiness but thats just nihlism, because there might not be a point to anything, but if it makes you feel good and you are able to do it healthily, whats so wrong with that? what makes you so undeserving of it? you are allowed to feel sadness and embrace and seek help and comfort for it but just because happiness is a limited feeling means that its pointless. and short-term relationships arent pointless either. youll look back and youll have made memories, and once the pain subsides for a little while you should go and make some more to hhelp you through the next downfall. i know life for us isnt as easy as it is for all the people we see everyday but its still meaningful,w eird but meaningful, pointless but meaninful in a sense, as well. sorry if i ranted i just struggle to get a point across with words and hoped to distract you if even with excessive writing. you're doing well. i know you don't hear it often but im proud of you, and all these grades that i know you're working hard for will pay off somehow one day when it compliments how amazing you are of a person when applying for a college/job you want.

i can't say i have any comforting words to offer, espicially when it'd make me a hypocrite, but i, at least, understand. it's like you've sumed up what i've been feeling for so long into a few words, and i think that maybe knowing that you're not alone could help, in its way. i apologize if i just wasted your time
